t: Sandtex 10Ltr Ultra Smooth Masonry Paint offers a high-performance, durable solution for exterior walls. Featuring advanced Microseal Technology, this paint creates a breathable, waterproof, and dirt-resistant finish. It is ideal for revitalising concrete, pebble-dash, render, and stone surfaces on a variety of properties. The creamy smooth formulation allows for easy application by brush, roller, or spray, providing excellent coverage of up to 16 square metres per litre. This water-based masonry paint is touch-dry and recoatable in 3-4 hours, facilitating efficient project turnaround in conditions above 8°C.
b: Suitable for Concrete, Pebble-Dash, Render & Stone
